findings.title: io_uring IORING_OP_SOCKET bypasses RestrictAddressFamilies, so AF_VSOCK to the Windows host stays open from every non-root unit (P1-13 not closed)
findings.where: systemd/ossbot-gatekeeper.service, systemd/ossbot-sandboxd.service, Phase 2 runner/hermes units; tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py; tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh; docs/VERIFICATION.md rows 31/32; ADR-0005 and ADR-0007 P1-13 addenda
findings.detail: In a systemd-run unit with the unit's user, RestrictAddressFamilies, NoNewPrivileges and SystemCallArchitectures=native (gatekeeper and ossbox), socket(AF_VSOCK) gets errno 97, but an IORING_OP_SOCKET submission returns a vsock fd and connect((2, 50002)) reaches the drvfs Plan 9 server. Kernel 6.18.54.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2, kernel.io_uring_disabled=0, no unit filters io_uring syscalls. The surface probe calls only socket(), so it passes against the bypass.
findings.action: Set kernel.io_uring_disabled=2 via sysctl.d and fail closed on drift (ossbot-firewall --check / watchdog firewall_drift, doctor). Add SystemCallFilter=~io_uring_setup io_uring_enter io_uring_register to every non-root unit and assert it in test_systemd_units.py. Add an IORING_OP_SOCKET variant to the unit-context, per-pool and proxy vsock probes, with an unrestricted io_uring control. Correct row 31 and the ADR-0005/0007 addenda, and record io_uring evidence for row 32.

findings.title: Listener allowlist covers TCP/UDP only
findings.action: In test_egress_surface.sh also check abstract unix sockets in the host netns (ss -Hxl names starting with @) against an allowlist, and restrict the ephemeral-UDP skip to sockets owned by known clients (ss -p).

findings.title: No cache-manager deny in squid.conf
findings.action: Add acl manager url_regex -i ^cache_object:// /squid-internal-mgr/ and http_access deny manager among the fast denies in sandbox/proxy/squid.conf.j2 (and the golden), so the web_public 'all' allow lines never decide cache manager requests.
